_howto: ONE file per instrument per timeframe -- the longest export. In TradingView, each
successive download of the same chart reaches further back and ends at the same point,
so the newest export is always the longest. Keep it, discard the earlier ones.
To add an instrument: create data/<root>/ , upload the CSVs, add an entry below with
just 'path'. bootstrap.py inventories it fresh and prints a paste-ready fingerprint
block. After that any silent change to the file gets caught.
Filenames carry their date range so a refreshed export can never silently replace a
different one -- the defect that invalidated the old '5 (4)' master.
